entries.text: A tall, imposing gentleman guards the door in a severe military uniform. A leather-bound register rests on the podium beside him.
The leather-bound guestbook reads: 'Steve Dorian, Yvette Delacroix, Rameses Najeer, and Dr. Olympia Myklos' among others in the registry of the evening's guests.

The leather-bound guestbook reads: 'Steve Dorian, Yvette Delacroix, Rameses Najeer, and Dr. Olympia Myklos' among others in the registry of the evening's guests.  Right below them, inscribed with unmistakable pride, is you: 'Laura Bow.'
Taking up the pen, you sign the guestbook with a flourish: 'Laura Bow.'
You have already signed the guest register; once is enough.
